title: EnHomee 6 Tier Shoe Rack for Entryway and Closet, Rustic Brown and Black | Homeowners & Renters, Holds 24 Pairs & Boots, Adjustable Tall Boot Sections
features: 【LARGE CAPACITY SHOE ORGANIZER】 EnHomee shoe racks hold up to 24 pairs, eliminating entryway clutter. Measuring 39.4"W x 11.8"D x 41.4"H, it fits closets, hallways, living rooms, and bedrooms for versatile storage.

【STURDY METAL SHOE RACK】 This metal and wood shoe rack has reinforced frame and boards for superior stability. 4 adjustable feet ensure balance on uneven floors while protecting flooring from scratches.
【MULTIFUNCTIONAL STORAGE】 The raised-edge wooden top securely holds bags, keys, plants, and décor. 4 rows of side hanging pockets store slippers, shoe covers, umbrellas, and sock bags.
【ADJUSTABLE FOR BOOTS】 This tall shoe rack for boots includes 2 high shelf sections (13.9"H). Small-space dwellers can detach 2 shelves for extra vertical clearance.
【EASY ASSEMBLY】 This wide shoe rack features simple structure with detailed instructions for quick assembly – even first-time homeowners can set it up easily.
